data.one_liner: Dart wrappers to write Firebase Cloud Functions
data.what_it_does: Provides JS interop for Firebase Admin and Functions, enabling Dart code to compile to JavaScript for Cloud Functions. It supports full interop for Firestore, HTTPS, and Identity services, with partial support for Admin Database and limited messaging.
use_when: You want to write Cloud Functions in Dart instead of JavaScript/TypeScript
You need full interop for Firestore, HTTPS, or Identity functions
You are building a Dart-only project that also deploys Cloud Functions
avoid_when: You only need Firebase services on the client side
You require Auth, Storage, or other services not yet supported
You prefer to stay in TypeScript/JavaScript for Cloud Functions
strengths: Full interop for Firestore, HTTPS, Identity
Build tool that compiles Dart to JS for Cloud Functions
weaknesses: Limited interop for many services (Auth, Storage, Messaging only partial)
Requires manual setup of firebase tools and build scripts
data.setup_notes: Install firebase tools, add firebase.json ignores, create build.dart, run dart run tool/build.dart, then firebase deploy. No build_runner needed.
